minutes_text:
OLD TOWN LA VERNE BUSINESS IMPROVEMENT DISTIRICT
  MINUTES OF THE ANNUAL MEETING
  Monday, February 3, 2025

1.  WELCOME AND CALL TO ORDER

  The meeting began without a quonrm at 8:16 a.m.

  Vice-Chairperson George Henderson welcomed attendees. The following board members
  were present: Zthey Espinoza and George Henderson. Not Present: Marianne Stark,
  Micky Rehm and Craig Walters.

2.  CALENDAR

  Cool Cruise Car Show - Saturday, April 19,2025 - 10am-4pm
  Wine Walk - Saturday, April 26,2025 - 5pm-8:30pm

3.  PRE,SENTATIONS

  Welcome and University of La Verne Update - Interim President Dr. Risa Dickson

  Dr. Dickson began by thanking the Fire and Police Departments for their response to the
  fires. Dr. Dickson stated that she previously worked at Cal State San Bernardino and
  most recently at the University of Hawaii. She started at the University of La Verne as
  the lnterim Provost and is now contracted for two years as the lnterim President as they
  search for a permanent president.

  Mayor's City Update - Tim Ilepburn

  Mayor Hepburn welcomed attendees and introduced City staff and the BID Board. Mayor
  Hepburn discussed the multiple events hosted by the District such as The Cool Cruise Car
  Show, The Wine Walk, mini summer concert series at Mainiero Square, Trick or Treating
  on Halloween, Cruisin La Verne Holiday Car Show, and the Holiday Stroll. He
  announced that a new street light pole program will begin this year for holiday d6cor and
  promotion of Old Town. Mayor Hepburn also announced the recently approved Outdoor
  Dining and Sidewalk Policy.

  Metro "A" (Gold) Line Update - Lisa Levy-Buch

  Lisa Levy Buch of the Gold Line Construction Authority presented a construction
  update. Ms. Buch announced that the Gold Line has been transferred to Metro for testing,
  23 of the 25 stations are now completed, and they are curently working through a punch
  list of items. A sidewalk is being constructed along Arrow Highway to connect D Street
   to the station. Ms. Levy-Buch also stated that in October LA County approved the
  extension of the line through Claremont.

  Chief Nigg had a question regarding a pedestrian crossing at D Street. Ms. Levy-Buch
  stated that she would investigate the concern.

  Presentation of Draft S-Year Action Plan - Nathan Ulsh, Community Strong
  Strategies

  Mr. Ulsh introduced Kelly Rankin of Civitas Advisors. Mr. Ulsh and Ms. Rankin
  presented the 5-Year Action Plan. They outlined the concerns as provided by the Board
  and merchants. The analysis provided a breakdown of weaknesses, strengths,
  opportunities, and recommendations. Mr. Ulsh stated that the next step is to finalize the
  report at the end of the month. Mr. Ulsh also stated that he is working on a partnership
  with the Chamber of Commerce and University.

4.  PUBLIC COMMENT (Any discussion or action on non-agendized items must be
  deferred to the following meeting, as required by california Brown Act Law)

  None

5.  ADJOURNMENT

  Meeting was adjourned at 9:18 a.m., the next regular meeting to be held on Monday,
  March 3,2025 at 8:30 a.m. at Caf6 Wang Restaurant.

  Respectively submitted,

  Natalie  Hiatt
